title: Martialytics vs Zen Planner (2026): Pricing by Student Count
description: Martialytics vs Zen Planner for martial arts schools: published price at your student count, belt tracking, add-ons, payments, trials and contracts.
body:
Martialytics and Zen Planner both run belt tracking, attendance, booking and billing for martial arts schools, and both price by how many active students or members you have. Martialytics is built only for martial arts schools and includes every feature on every tier. Zen Planner also serves gyms and studios, and sells its website, Engage marketing, branded app and card reader as add-ons or bundles. Sources: Martialytics pricing (checked 2026-11-07) and Zen Planner active-member tiers (checked 2026-11-09). Anything a vendor doesn't publish is marked unknown.

At every headcount shown, Martialytics' published price is lower than Zen Planner Studio: $30/mo less at 40 students and $110/mo less at 200. The two count heads differently. Martialytics counts active students and doesn't charge for leads or inactive students. Zen Planner counts anyone with a membership or who attended in the past month, and doesn't count prospects, staff, alumni or pay-per-session attendees. Neither publishes annual pricing; Zen Planner offers an annual contract on request.

What costs extra on Zen Planner

Zen Planner Studio is the base plan. Essentials adds a website ($198-$388/mo) and Ultimate adds the website plus Engage marketing ($348-$538/mo). Add-ons are Engage $249/mo, Website $99/mo, a branded app $39/mo and a card reader (Lane 3600) $39/mo. Martialytics includes every feature on every plan, with unlimited users, locations and emails.

Belts, attendance and booking

  • Martialytics: grading-readiness tracking, a student app with lessons sectioned by rank, engagement tracking with automatic absence follow-up, a Kiosk Mode check-in app, and bookings and events with a calendar and capacity limits.
  • Zen Planner: belt and skill tracking, attendance, and online class scheduling with waitlists, capacity limits and automatic reminders. Members book online or from the app.

Payments, trials and contracts

  • Martialytics: standard Stripe rates with no markup or revenue percentage, a 30-day free trial with no credit card, and no lock-in contracts.
  • Zen Planner: Daxko Payments or preferred processors, with rates not published (Zen Planner Payments is custom-priced). Free trial: unknown. Month-to-month, with an annual contract on request.

Which to pick

  • Martial arts school that wants every feature at one published price: Martialytics. {{aff:martialytics|See Martialytics plans}}
  • Mixed gym or studio that also wants Zen Planner's website, Engage marketing or branded app: Zen Planner. Compare the Essentials and Ultimate bundles with the add-on prices first. {{aff:zenplanner|See Zen Planner pricing}}

faq: Is Martialytics cheaper than Zen Planner?

On published prices, yes, at every headcount we compared. At 40 students it's $69 vs $99/mo (Zen Planner Studio), at 100 it's $99 vs $189, and at 200 it's $129 vs $239 (martialytics.com/pricing checked 2026-11-07, Zen Planner active-member tiers checked 2026-11-09).
Do Martialytics and Zen Planner track belts?
Yes. Martialytics tracks grading readiness, and its student app sections lessons by rank. Zen Planner lists belt and skill tracking.
Does Zen Planner charge for a website or branded app?
Yes. The website is $99/mo on its own or comes in Essentials, a branded app is $39/mo, and a card reader is $39/mo. Engage marketing is $249/mo or included in Ultimate.
Do Martialytics or Zen Planner require a contract?
Martialytics says there are no lock-in contracts. Zen Planner is month-to-month by default, with an annual contract on request.
